name: drawer-demo
title: Drawer demo
description: A daily goal set with buttons in a bottom drawer, with a handle to drag it away.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHandle, DrawerHeader, DrawerOverlay, DrawerTitle, Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerPortal, DrawerTrigger, } from '@/ui/drawer/drawer'; /** * A daily goal set with buttons in a bottom drawer, with a handle to drag * it away. The goal is announced as it changes. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-drawer-demo', imports: [ Button, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHandle, DrawerHeader, DrawerOverlay, DrawerTitle, Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerPortal, DrawerTrigger, NdIcon, ], template: `

Move goal

Set your daily activity goal.

{{ goal() }} Calories a day

`, }) export class DrawerDemoExample { protected readonly goal = signal(350); /** * Moves the goal by a step, between 200 and 400. * * @param step - How much to add. */ protected change(step: number): void { this.goal.update((goal) => Math.min(400, Math.max(200, goal + step))); } }
